Extrapyramidal and movement disorders arise from nervous system dysfunction; abnormal movement alone does not establish skeletal muscle damage.

Skeletal connective tissue abnormalities and aortic disease characterize this group; damaging ocular findings vary by subtype and are not established as common across the umbrella.
Inflammation of the diaphragm, a skeletal muscle; respiratory function does not itself establish lung damage, and inflammation alone does not prove immune mediation.
Pigmentary and vascular malformations define disease; HPO reports cortical atrophy in 80-99% and glaucoma in 30-79%. Reduced bone density (80-99%) omitted by four-axis cap.
Acquired purine metabolic disturbance with xanthine accumulation; crystal nephropathy and renal failure are explicitly rare, so renal involvement is excluded.
